problem_text:
A logistics manager must select packages to load onto a cargo drone. Available packages are:
* Package A: volume 19 m³, revenue $10
* Package B: volume 45 m³, revenue $239
* Package C: volume 40 m³, revenue $246
* Package D: volume 1 m³, revenue $121
* Package E: volume 20 m³, revenue $68
* Package F: volume 50 m³, revenue $164
* Package G: volume 35 m³, revenue $89
* Package H: volume 28 m³, revenue $251
* Package I: volume 6 m³, revenue $264
* Package J: volume 49 m³, revenue $128
The drone's cargo hold has a maximum capacity of 205 m³. Choose the package combination that maximizes total revenue without exceeding this volume limit. Each package is either fully loaded or not loaded.
